facts.en: Completed a language studies bachelor degree at Fictional Copper Finch College in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构铜雀学院取得语言研究学士学位。

facts.en: Customer support associate at Fictional Prism Desk, 2019-02 to 2022-08.
facts.zh: 2019-02 至 2022-08 在虚构棱镜台机构任客户支持专员。

facts.en: Support content coordinator at Fictional Prism Desk, 2022-09 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2022-09 至 2026-08 在虚构棱镜台机构任支持内容协调员。

facts.en: Edited setup articles after checking steps with a product specialist; did not make product-roadmap decisions.
facts.zh: 与产品专员核对步骤后编辑设置文章；不做产品路线图决策。

facts.en: Maintained 64 live help articles in 2026-08; an archive inventory of 91 included obsolete articles and was not the active count.
facts.zh: 2026-08 维护 64 篇在线帮助文章；档案清单中的 91 篇包含过时文章，不是活跃数量。

facts.en: Worked with 2 support colleagues and a designer on navigation labels in 2025-01.
facts.zh: 2025-01 与 2 名支持同事及一名设计师合作调整导航标签。

facts.en: Personally summarized search queries and drafted label alternatives; the designer selected the final information architecture.
facts.zh: 个人负责总结搜索查询并起草备选标签；最终信息架构由设计师选择。

facts.en: In a moderated test during 2025-02, 9 of 12 participants found the reset article without assistance; an earlier test used different participants and cannot establish improvement.
facts.zh: 2025-02 主持测试中，12 名参与者有 9 名无需协助找到重置文章；此前测试使用不同参与者，不能据此证明改善。

facts.en: Uses Markdown, screenshot annotations, and version-history comparisons.
facts.zh: 使用 Markdown、截图标注及版本历史比较。

facts.en: Reads simple HTML markup to fix links; no JavaScript development experience is documented.
facts.zh: 阅读简单 HTML 标记以修复链接；未记录 JavaScript 开发经验。

facts.en: Drafted an AI-assisted article review proposal in 2026-03; it was not approved and no customer data was uploaded.
facts.zh: 2026-03 起草 AI 辅助文章审核提案；未获批准，且未上传客户数据。

facts.en: Created English-to-Chinese draft translations for 6 help articles in 2025; a reviewer finalized them.
facts.zh: 2025 年为 6 篇帮助文章制作英译中初稿；由审核者定稿。

facts.en: No standardized language proficiency score is provided; draft translation work does not establish certified proficiency.
facts.zh: 未提供标准化语言水平分数；翻译初稿工作不代表经认证的语言水平。

facts.en: Part-time workshop note-taker at Fictional Ink Room, 2020-10 to 2021-04, averaging 4 hours weekly alongside full-time support work.
facts.zh: 2020-10 至 2021-04 在虚构墨室兼职担任工作坊记录员，与全职支持工作同期，平均每周 4 小时。

facts.en: Maintains a personal illustrated soup-recipe notebook begun in 2024; no commercial readership is claimed.
facts.zh: 维护始于 2024 年的个人插画汤谱笔记；不声称拥有商业读者。

facts.en: A handover note calls the navigation project launched in 2025-03, while an undated draft calls it pending; launch status requires confirmation.
facts.zh: 交接备注称导航项目于 2025-03 上线，但一份未注明日期的草稿称其待上线；上线状态需确认。

facts.en: Maintained a review queue showing article owner and next review date.
facts.zh: 维护显示文章负责人及下次审核日期的审核队列。

facts.en: No direct staff management, customer-support chatbot deployment, or product analytics ownership is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录直属人员管理、客户支持聊天机器人部署或产品分析负责经历。
